page.overview:
What is Oathbringer?

Oathbringer is an epic fantasy novel written by American author Brandon Sanderson and the tthumbhird book in The Stormlight Archive series. It was published by Tor Books on November 14, 2017. Oathbringer consists of one prologue, 122 chapters, 14 interludes and an epilogue.

It is preceded by Words of Radiance. As with its Stormlight Archive predecessors, the unabridged audiobook is read by narrator team Michael Kramer and Kate Reading. Category:Fantasy Category:Novel Category:The Stormlight Archive Category:Cosmere
